title: Thieves Guild
description: Riften's brotherhood of thieves: restoring the Guild, Mercer Frey's betrayal and the Nightingales of Nocturnal.

items.title: A Chance Arrangement
items.description: Brynjolf tests you at the Riften market: steal Madesi's ring and plant it in Brand-Shei's pocket.
tips: Brynjolf is at the market by day; at night look for him in the Bee and Barb.

items.title: Taking Care of Business
items.description: Collect debts from three Riften merchants (Keerava, Haelga and Bersi Honey-Hand) and join the Guild.
tips: Every merchant has a weak spot; Talen-Jei can tell you about Keerava.

items.title: Loud and Clear
items.description: Break into Goldenglow Estate, burn three beehives and take the papers from Aringoth's safe.
tips: Besides the main entrance, a sewer tunnel leads into the estate, which makes sneaking in easier.

items.title: Dampened Spirits
items.description: Team up with Mallus Maccius to ruin Sabjorn's business at Honningbrew Meadery by poisoning the mead before the guard captain's visit.

items.title: Scoundrel's Folly
items.description: Find out from Gulum-Ei in Solitude who is behind the Guild's troubles. The trail leads to Karliah, a former Guild member.
tips: Tail Gulum-Ei to the East Empire Company Warehouse without letting him spot you.

items.title: Speaking With Silence
items.description: Track down Karliah in Snow Veil Sanctum with Mercer. The truth turns out very different from Mercer's story.

items.title: Hard Answers
items.description: Decode Gallus's journal: Enthir at the College of Winterhold sends you to Calcelmo in Markarth for help.

items.title: The Pursuit
items.description: Break into Mercer Frey's home, Riftweald Manor, and find out where he went.
items.missable: The sword Chillrend sits in a display case in Riftweald Manor. Take it during this quest.

items.title: Trinity Restored
items.description: Become a Nightingale of Nocturnal alongside Karliah and Brynjolf and receive the Nightingale Armor.

items.title: Blindsighted
items.description: Catch up with Mercer in the Dwemer ruins of Irkngthand, where he is after the Eyes of the Falmer, and recover the Skeleton Key.
tips: Right after the quest the Skeleton Key opens any lock and never breaks. Use it before you return it.

items.title: Darkness Returns
items.description: Return the Skeleton Key to the Twilight Sepulcher, walk the Pilgrim's Path and choose Nocturnal's gift.
items.missable: Once you return the key, it is gone for good. Your choice of Nightingale power is final.

choices.question: Which Nightingale power do you choose?

options.label: Agent of Shadow (crescent moon)
options.result: Once a day: invisibility for 120 seconds while sneaking.

options.label: Agent of Strife (full moon)
options.result: Once a day: absorb 100 points of health from an enemy.

options.label: Agent of Subterfuge (half moon)
options.result: Once a day: nearby enemies fight each other for 30 seconds.

items.title: Under New Management
items.description: Become Guild Master of the Thieves Guild. Unlocks after the main questline and restoring the Guild's influence in all four cities.
tips: You get the Guild Master's Armor and access to the Guild Master's tribute chest, refilled every week.

items.title: Imitation Amnesty
items.description: Help get a convicted prisoner out of the Whiterun jail. Reward: jewelry and a Guild upgrade.
tips: Unlocks after five jobs from Vex and Delvin in that city. Upgrades the Ragged Flagon and lets you bribe the hold's guards.
Olfrid Battle-Born in Whiterun gives the details.

items.title: The Dainty Sload
items.description: Frame a ship's captain to get revenge for a cheated merchant. Reward: a random spell tome.
tips: Unlocks after five jobs from Vex and Delvin in that city. Upgrades the Ragged Flagon and lets you bribe the hold's guards.

items.title: Silver Lining
items.description: Recover the stolen mold from Pinewatch for the silversmith Endon. Reward: enchanted armor, and Endon becomes a Guild fence.
tips: Unlocks after five jobs from Vex and Delvin in that city. Upgrades the Ragged Flagon and lets you bribe the hold's guards.

items.title: Summerset Shadows
items.description: Get a rival guild, the Summerset Shadows, out of the way. Niranye becomes a Guild fence.
tips: Unlocks after five jobs from Vex and Delvin in that city. Upgrades the Ragged Flagon and lets you bribe the hold's guards.

items.title: No Stone Unturned
items.description: Collect all 24 Stones of Barenziah across Skyrim and restore the Crown of Barenziah.
tips: You can collect the stones in advance; Vex gives the quest.

items.title: Reparations
items.description: Kill a Guild member and you are expelled. To return, you have to pay off the debt.
items.missable: Until the debt is paid, all Guild quests are unavailable.

items.title: The Litany of Larceny
items.description: Delvin asks you to grab special items that turn up during Guild quests. Each one pays gold.

items.title: Vald's Debt
items.description: You need Vald's key to get into Riftweald Manor. Find the quill for Maven Black-Briar to clear Vald's debt, and he hands over the key.

items.title: The Burglary Job
items.description: Steal a specific item from a wealthy home.

items.title: The Shill Job
items.description: Plant "evidence" in a wealthy home.

items.title: The Sweep Job
items.description: Steal three specific valuables from a wealthy home.

items.title: The Heist Job
items.description: Steal a specific item from a shop.

items.title: The Numbers Job
items.description: Doctor a shop's ledger.

items.title: The Fishing Job
items.description: Pickpocket an item from a specific person.

items.title: The Bedlam Job
items.description: Steal a set amount of goods in a city.
tips: On Solstheim (Raven Rock) this job is bugged and never completes.
